name: use-scroll-edges
description: Where a scroll container currently sits between its ends, on both axes — the state a Fade binds its isVisible to, since a ramp at an edge means there is more content that way. A passive scroll listener rather than an observer, deliberately: the question is the offset itself rather than a boolean, and the IntersectionObserver equivalent needs a sentinel node pinned at every edge. Paired with a ResizeObserver for the container AND a commit-time re-measure, because content appended to an already-full list resizes nothing and a ResizeObserver alone never fires. Takes the absolute value of the inline offset, since an RTL container scrolls to a negative scrollLeft.
